description: Checks an IPv4 address against the Tor Project's bulk exit list (about 1,200 active exit IPs). If it is an exit, adds the relays for that address from Onionoo: nickname, flags, country, first and last seen. Only exit IPs are on the list; a relay's other IPs are not checked. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_tor_exit_nodes
title: Security Tor Exit Nodes
